svg.title: ARIMA walk-forward validation, test, and future forecast results
svg.desc: A three-panel chart of fictional weekly repair requests. The first panel shows the ordered training, validation, final test, and eight-week future periods with a widening 95 percent interval. The second panel compares five ARIMA orders by validation mean absolute error and selects order 2, 1, 0 at 2.27 requests. The third panel compares one-week-ahead test predictions: selected ARIMA MAE is 3.04 requests and last-week baseline MAE is 3.42 requests.
